name: AIWhyThisLink
description: The rationale disclosure entry point. Five variants — why this, view rationale, view sources, view assumptions, explain risk — each with its own icon and default label.
intent: Make the reasoning reachable in one interaction.

props.name: variant
props.hint: Optional. Declared in the component source.

props.name: label
props.hint: Optional. Declared in the component source.

props.name: className
props.hint: Merged with the component classes via cn(). Use for layout only — never to override a variant that already exists.

variants.name: explain-risk
variants.when: Opens risk context. Pair with a high-risk badge.

requiredAttributes: A label — the default is used when none is given
notes: Renders a button, not a link: it discloses in place rather than navigating.
If it opens a panel, that panel must receive focus — otherwise a keyboard user activates it and nothing appears to happen.

usage: Beside any AI output the user may question
In an approval flow, so reasoning precedes the decision
Wherever a citation or assumption underlies a claim
doNotUse: When there is no rationale to show — an unwired link promises transparency and does not deliver
As a general help link — use ui:button variant="link"
Where the explanation should simply be visible instead
Rendering with no rationale behind it
Opening a panel without moving focus
Use as a general help link

agentRules: Only render it when real rationale exists behind onClick.
Move focus into whatever it opens.
Its presence is what satisfies the Rationale disclosure obligation — do not claim that obligation without it.
Place it before the decision, not after.

gaps.reason: No Figma file, node, or Code Connect mapping in the spec or manifest.
